crossRefs.note: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
crossRefs.keyword: smote down. Heb. made to bow. chosen men. or, young men

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
translations.bsb: God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.
translations.kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
translations.asv: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the fattest of them, And smote down the young men of Israel.
